failedAttempts: The first real upgrade redirected pnpm to an empty staged store and failed with ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE; the original home was unchanged and the bound residue was recovered before retry.
The first bwrap layout mounted the staged home before a /tmp tmpfs, which hid temporary homes; bind-fd after tmpfs fixed the ordering and a real bwrap test now covers it.
An initial lock wrapper used ambiguous flock fd-and-command syntax and created files named 3 and 4; trace identified the cause, the wrapper now locks fds before exec, and the artifacts were removed.
A broad third-party dependency rejection was narrowed to active composed third-party rows so inactive library dependencies remain preserved.
